name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 7 killed, 80 injured in day to 14 Nov
summary: Russian strikes killed 7 and injured 80 across Ukraine in a day to 14 Nov; 50 hurt in Zaporizhzhia city on 13 Nov
state: Russian attacks killed at least seven people and injured 80 across Ukraine in the day to 14 Nov, with Zaporizhzhia region worst hit at three killed and 62 injured, according to regional governors (Kyiv Independent). A strike on apartment buildings in Zaporizhzhia city on 13 Nov injured 50, including eight children (Ukrinform, citing the regional administration). Ukraine's General Staff said it hit an oil facility in Samara region and the Lipetsk-2 airbase on 13–14 Nov. Talks continue without a ceasefire, and mass-casualty strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: People in or travelling to Ukraine face missile and drone strikes and power cuts; the FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine. Energy and grain markets can react to strikes on ports, refineries and power networks.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes: 80 injured nationwide in a day to 14 Nov, 50 in one Zaporizhzhia strike on 13 Nov
